Selecting the right CRM depends on your team size, budget, and primary goal (sales tracking vs. all-in-one marketing).[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GObnsNMNakQ&t=74)

#### Top CRM Options for Small Businesses

- **HubSpot CRM** — *Best overall for growing businesses and ease of use* 
	- **Highlights:** Offers a robust free tier, intuitive contact management, built-in email tracking, and clean pipeline views. It scales seamlessly as you grow without feeling overly complex.
	- **Learn more:** Check out the HubSpot Pricing Overview.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GObnsNMNakQ&t=74)
- **Zoho CRM** — *Best for deep customization and value* 
	- **Highlights:** Highly flexible modules, strong lead-capture tools, and built-in AI assistant features (Zia) at a fraction of enterprise cost.
	- **Learn more:** Explore the platform via Zoho Corporation.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GObnsNMNakQ&t=224)
- **Pipedrive** — *Best dedicated sales pipeline CRM* 
	- **Highlights:** Built specifically for sales teams to track deals visually with a drag-and-drop interface. Fast to set up and very user-friendly for beginners.
	- **Learn more:** Compare features on [Pipedrive](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/crm-comparison/pipedrive-vs-monday).
- **ActiveCampaign** — *Best for marketing automation and email campaigns* 
	- **Highlights:** Combines solid CRM contact tracking with industry-leading email marketing, drip campaigns, and behavior-based triggers.
	- **Learn more:** Review options at [ActiveCampaign](https://www.activecampaign.com/blog/marketing-software).
- **Insightly** — *Best for businesses that combine sales with project management* 
	- **Highlights:** Automatically converts won deals into active post-sale projects so your sales and delivery teams stay synced.
	- **Learn more:** Read details on Insightly.

If you'd like to narrow this down, tell me:

- **How many people** will be using the CRM?
- Is your main focus **sales tracking**, **email marketing** , or **customer support**?
